caption: The drawing features a repeating pattern set against a medium gray background. The primary elements are two male figures dressed in historical attire, each holding a long firearm, accompanied by dogs. These figures are placed at intervals within the composition. There are also repeating sections of garden-like architecture, including white trellises, a white pagoda-like structure with a pointed roof, and clusters of tall, narrow shrubs. Interspersed throughout the scene are various flowers and foliage in shades of white, light blue, black, and teal, forming clusters around the human figures, dogs, and architectural elements. The overall composition is arranged in a dense, tapestry-like manner, with no empty spaces, and the objects are consistently rendered in a limited palette of whites, grays, blacks, and muted blue-green tones.
title: Wallpaper
